description: Election Commission - Notify the appointment of D. M. Ajith Kumara, elected as the member of the Welimada Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Welimada Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process, specifically the nomination and declaration of a new elected member, which falls under the Elections category.
